messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "see disposal information for safe disposal"
set: ["see disposal information for safe disposal", "ask pharmacist about drug take-back disposal program", "see detailed dosage information for full list", "prescribing information contains storage information for different brands while in use", "ask your doctor or pharmacist for more information", "check the prescribing information", "visit www.fda.gov/drugdisposal for more information on disposing of unused medicines", "has safe and dangerous doses", "access information online at Poison Help", "pharmacist can provide more information about storage", "difference is between safe and dangerous doses", "read information every time even if taken before", "keep in a safe place to protect from theft", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not", "store in safe place to prevent stealing or abuse", "ask doctor if safe to breastfeed while using medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
